section_summary.extract_value: This Results section reports descriptive statistics and bivariate correlations (referenced in Table 1), showing that participants were more oriented toward appearance than performance and that women's body-as-process attitudes were more positive than body-as-object scores. Correlational patterns indicate exercise is positively related to body appreciation and process orientation, while conversations about weight loss and dieting are negatively associated with body appreciation; no study numbering or participant demographics (e.g., N, age, country, BMI) are provided here.
